comments.body:
The Bergen/Edinburgh area is also a good place for this.

If u have Cooking Skill for milling process u can make the flour from the wheat in Bergen as well as buy the cheese there, and if u have Fishing Skill and Storage u can catch and prep the fish on the sea while sailing between the cities, finally Edinburgh has cows which with the Cooking Skill can be processed into milk and then the milk processed into cheese.
